section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports analyses on a combined sample (MTurk and college participants) with regression analyses based on 257 cases. Self-compassion positively predicted body appreciation and moderated the negative relationships of body comparison and appearance contingent self-worth with body appreciation, such that these negative associations were weaker at higher levels of self-compassion.
